added.summary: Marks a light that never moves or changes. Nothing changes while RenderSettings.staticLightReach is 0 (the default); a light that casts a shadow or has a cookie is always shaded per pixel. The three components grow a field, so a world with any of them hashes differently; what its ticks do is unchanged.

Past this many metres from a static light, its diffuse light comes from a 32 × 12 × 32 grid of probes round the camera (half the reach apart, recomputed on the CPU when the camera moves a cell or a static light changes) instead of being shaded per pixel, and a static rect light sends rough surfaces (roughness 0.5 or more) nothing there. Glossy surfaces keep every static light's highlights. The grid takes 0.6 MB of GPU memory while it is on; nothing is baked or downloaded.
